Package io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities

Class Student

java.lang.Object
io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities.Entity
io.mapjhak.goosepatrol.entities.Student
public class Student extends Entity
Student class. Stores the player character, its inventory and sanity. Handles movement, aiming and item use. Inputs are managed by StudentController
